Save this video before you next have guests over 🌻 Britex has been helping Aussies tackle tough stains for over 40 years, so their everyday range is a must have in the home as we head into entertaining season. Which area surprised you the most? 🌻 
1. Old carpet spills can still smell if they haven’t been cleaned properly. Britex Spot n Stain is amazing for lifting tough stains, old and new, from deep inside carpet fibres.
2. Tough urine and vomit stains? Britex Urine Remover is a game changer. Its no-touch formula means you simply spray, cover and let it do the work, without heavy scrubbing.
3. Don’t forget your vacuum filter! It can hold onto smells, so make sure you wash it regularly to keep your vacuum fresh.
4. Couches, bedheads and mattresses can trap cooking and pet odours. Britex Odour Blaster helps eliminate odours from the source, rather than just masking them.
5. Add ½ cup citric acid and baking soda to your drain, then flush with hot water to help clean and deodorise.

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx @britexcarpetcare 

#tipsandtricks #hometips #cleaninghacks #mamamilastips #homefragrance

A top request! 🌻 Did you know those yellow sweat stains aren’t actually just sweat? They’re caused by a mix of sweat, body oils + the aluminium found in many antiperspirants, which can build up in the fabric and leave those stubborn yellow marks.

This simple laundry trick helps break down that buildup and bring your whites back to life. Save this video for your next laundry day ☁️ hope this was helpful lovelies xx 

#laundryhacks #cleaningtips #cleaninghacks #laundrytips #tipsandtricks
items.transcript: Here's the trick to remove tough sweat stains from your clothes. In a bowl, mix half a cup of baking soda, half a cup of hydrogen peroxide, and one teaspoon of dish soap to cut through any oil-based stain. This mix is amazing at combating underarm stains. Just apply it straight to the stain and buff it in with a brush. Then wash as usual, and stains will disappear.

You’ll never see another spider web in your home with tip #5 🙌 As we enter the warmer months and open up our doors + windows, these tricks will make sure the bugs and spiders stay outside where they belong and not inside your home ♥️ hope these tips are helpful lovelies xx 

1. Simmer lemon, rosemary + clove (I like to add some vanilla too but that’s optional), spiders hate these smells so allow this fragrance to fill your home
2. And you can bottle this mix + use it as a surface spray around your windows (avoiding pet areas!) 
3. Place bay leaves in your pantry to keep pantry bugs away 
4. Place lemons and orange peels around your drains then flush with boiling water to keep bugs from entering through the drains 
5. And wipe peppermint oil on your ceilings to prevent spiders and spider webs

Which one will you try first?

#6 is the trick to never lose a sock in laundry again 🧦 Save these 7 tricks before your next laundry day to make your clothes look and smell amazing for longer 🧺 which one will you be trying first? 
1. A musty washing machine will cause musty clothes, so make sure youre emptying your drain pump and filter regularly to clear stagnant water
2. Take off your detergent tray and clean it to remove hidden build up
3. When washing clothes make sure to fasten zips as they can damage other clothes in the spin cycle and cause fading
4. But leave buttons open as they can pull in the wash
5. You can also wash new dark clothes with 1 cup epsom salt to prevent fading
6. Wash and dry socks in a mesh laundry bag to never lose a sock in the laundry again
7. Use less detergent - 1 tbs is often all you need too much can leave a build up and makes clothes feel stiff

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx 

#laundrytips #tipsandtricks #mamamilastips #homehacks
items.transcript: Before you do your next load of laundry, try these seven tricks to make your clothes look and smell so much better. Fresh clothes start with a clean machine, so make sure your machine's drain pump is empty as all that stagnant water can cause musty smell. Then clean your detergent tray to remove hidden buildup. Always make sure to fasten zips, but leave buttons open as they can pull in the wash. And you can also wash in your darks with one cup of Epsom salt to prevent fading. Wash and dry your socks in a mesh laundry bag and you will never lose a sock in laundry again. And use less detergent. One tablespoon is often all you need. Too much can leave a buildup and make clothes feel stiff.

1. Keep fruit flies away by adding cinnamon to your fruit bowl - they hate the smell!
2. Clean water bottles with 2 denture tablets to remove stains + odours. Soak for 10 mins then wash as usual.
3. Mix 1 cup water, 1 tbs dish soap and 1 tbs lemon juice to make an amazing kitchen degreasing spray
4. And you can use this mix on stovetop burners with steel wool to leave them sparkling
5. Heat a spoon in boiling water before measuring honey so it doesn’t stick to the spoon

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx

items.transcript: Here's the trick to make your white clothes look new again. Start by placing your whites into warm water. Add half a cup of hydrogen peroxide to brighten and disinfect your clothes. Then one cup of baking soda to brighten and neutralize odors. Then one tablespoon of dishwashing liquid to target any oil-based stains. Allow this mix to soak for one to two hours. Pop it in a whites-only wash and clothes are significantly whitened and brightened.

TYSM for 3M 🥹 I started this channel in 2020 as a way to share simple and time saving ways to make your home look and feel amazing. It’s such a joy to bring you daily tips, tricks and DIYs to help you transform your home into a beautiful space and I’m so grateful to each and everyone one of you for following along 🌻 as always, if you have any requests for future videos, let me know in the comments below! Here’s a recap of some of your favourite tips from this year so far 💛
1. Prevent hard water marks on your taps by buffing in a thin layer of candle wax
2. Clean your bins with peppermint oil to repel bugs and spiders
3. If your clothes are covered in hair or fluff, throw a baby wipe into the wash to grab all the lint and hair 
4. Boil coffee, cinnamon and vanilla on your stovetop to make your home smell amazing before guests arrive
5. And you can also place coffee anywhere you need odours removed 
6. A mix of 1 cup hydrogen peroxide and 20 drops clove oil is amazing at cutting through tough mould all around your home
7. And wipe doors with lavender oil to keep bugs and spiders away 

Hope these are helpful lovelies xx 

#hometips #homehacks #tipsandtricks #mamamilastips #homesweethome
